description: Edit an existing hosted doc by replacing a snippet of its HTML. DEFAULT TOOL for ANY edit to a doc the user already has — typo, copy change, restyle, new section, anything. ~50 tokens instead of ~7000 for re-hosting. Workflow: (1) if you don't have the current HTML in context, call `get_doc_html` first to read it. (2) construct `before_snippet` as a unique chunk of the existing HTML and `after_snippet` as its replacement. Pass EITHER `doc_name` (easiest) OR `slug`. Ambiguous match → fails with context for each candidate. Preserves share link, password, view counts, comments. Patching sends only the changed snippet, so it costs far less than re-sending a whole doc. For several edits at once ("fix the typo AND change the CTA AND update the date") pass a `patches` array instead of before/after: all of them land atomically or none do, each validated after the previous one applied.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

after_snippet.description: Replacement text. For a single edit.

before_snippet.description: Exact text to find (must be unique unless occurrence_index given). For a single edit.

doc_name.description: Name of the doc to edit (same name you passed to host_html_content). Use this if you don't have the slug.

occurrence_index.description: 0-based index of which match to replace when before_snippet isn't unique

patches.description: Several edits applied atomically. Use this OR before_snippet/after_snippet.

slug.description: Share-link slug or full URL. Alternative to doc_name.

name: patch_doc
title: Edit a doc (snippet patch)
